invariants.rationale: The method returns a new BulkInsertPartitioner instance for supported sortMode values.
The method only returns for NONE or GLOBAL_SORT; otherwise, it throws an exception.
When sortMode is NONE, the returned object is an instance of JavaNonSortPartitioner.
When sortMode is GLOBAL_SORT, the returned object is an instance of JavaGlobalSortPartitioner.
Any returned object must be a BulkInsertPartitioner.
